第86章 玉箫番外（完）-《反派BOSS有毒》

我受封北山之主的那天，亦是她十里红妆嫁给他人之时，那个时候我以为我和她的交集将终止在那里。

我们是两小无猜的青梅竹马，曾经我也以为，我会娶她为妻。

我们会有可爱的孩子，会一生一世相伴，直至生命枯竭。

可惜现实给了我狠狠的一击，不知从什么时候开始，我和她渐渐的疏远。

不，准确的来说，是她在疏远我。

就算见面，她口中永远都挂着一个名字。

一个完全陌生的名字。

她说起那个人的时候，脸上的表情是我从来没见过，那么的小心翼翼，那么的甜蜜……

我曾想过，如果我告诉她，我喜欢她，她会不会在回头看我一眼。

可是理智告诉我，不能说。

说了。

也许连朋友都做不成了。

她的爱是炽烈的，如飞蛾扑火的义无反顾，一旦知道自己对她怀有别样的感情，她会彻底远离自己。

这不是我想看到的。

所以，我没说。

我受封北山之主，站在北山之巅，目送她嫁入北海，站在这里，我能一直看着她所在的方向。

那样，也许我就离她更近了。

我从来没想过，有一天，她会满身血污的爬上北山，看到她那个样子，我当时恨不得扇自己两巴掌，为什么要选北山，这个地方是仙界最险峻最高的山峰。

我无法想像，她是怎么在全身修为尽废，身负重伤的情况下爬上北山。

北海龙族被灭，她能活着出来，全靠她夫君以死相拼，为的，是护住最后一丝血脉。

那是一个极小的婴儿，可是当她将那个小小的婴儿交给我的时候，我掀开染血被褥看到的却是一团青灰的小脸。

她已经死了。

“救救她，商哥哥。”

我抱着已经冰凉的婴儿，不知该作何反应。

“商哥哥……求你……她是我最后的希望，求你救救她……”

我想救她，可她告诉我，她用了血祭之术，无法转世，我没办法救她，她一个劲的求我，救她的孩子。

我眼睁睁的看着她在我面前灰飞烟灭，在那一瞬间，我似乎明白了什么叫心如死灰。

可是我不能死。

我必须要救这个婴儿，因为这是她对我最后的请求。

我将她的衣物埋葬在北山之巅，在那里，她可以看着他夫君葬身的北海。

The day I was named the Lord of Beishan was also the day when she married someone else. At that time, I thought the intersection between me and her would end there.

We were childhood sweethearts, and I once thought I would marry her.

We will have lovely children who will accompany us throughout our lives until our lives are exhausted.

It's a pity that reality gave me a hard blow. I don't know since when, she and I gradually became alienated.

No, to be precise, she is alienating me.

Even if we meet, she will always have a name on her lips.

A completely unfamiliar name.

When she talked about that person, the expression on her face was something I had never seen before, so careful and sweet...

I once thought that if I told her that I liked her, would she look back at me?

But my reason tells me that I can’t say it.

Said.

Maybe we can’t even be friends.

Her love is fierce, like a moth flying into a flame without hesitation. Once she knows that she has other feelings for her, she will stay away from herself completely.

This is not what I want to see.

So, I didn't say it.

I was named the Lord of Beishan and stood on the top of Beishan, watching her marry into Beihai. Standing here, I can always look in the direction where she is.

That way, maybe I'll be closer to her.

I never thought that one day, she would climb up Beishan Mountain covered in blood. When I saw her like that, I wanted to slap myself twice. Why should I choose Beishan? This place is the most dangerous and highest mountain in the fairy world.

I can't imagine how she climbed up Beishan Mountain with all her cultivation skills gone and serious injuries.

The Beihai Dragon Clan was wiped out, and she was able to come out alive only because her husband fought to the death to protect the last trace of his blood.

It was a very small baby, but when she handed the tiny baby to me, what I saw when I lifted up the blood-stained quilt was a small gray face.

She is dead.

"Save her, Brother Shang."

I held the already cold baby in my arms, not knowing how to react.

"Brother Shang...please...she is my last hope, please save her..."

I wanted to save her, but she told me that she had used the art of blood sacrifice and could not be reincarnated. I could not save her. She kept begging me to save her child.

I watched her disappear into ashes in front of me. At that moment, I seemed to understand what it meant to be heartbroken.

But I can't die.

I had to save this baby because this was her last request from me.

I buried her clothes on the top of Beishan, where she could look at the Beihai where her husband was buried.
